description: Session is active (user-owned turn in progress). Busy delivery must not steer the active turn. Current policy: idle_wake only — message deferred until session is idle.
expected_behavior: No inbox delivery while busy. Delivery remains pending for natural-turn fallback.

open_decision.description: If a future proof shows inbox delivery during a busy turn queues a distinct *following* turn (not mid-turn steering), busy_queue capability can be enabled.
required_evidence: Windows disposable trace showing inbox message received during active turn
Confirmation it creates a distinct following turn, not tool-boundary injection
No mechanism to steer or modify the currently active human-owned turn
